to limits false positives


Signed-off-by: Philippe Ombredanne <pombredanne@nexb.com>

items.title: Add new bsd/mit license crossover
items.body:
This is based has been reported by @jgunthorpe as part of the work on adding SPDX ids in the Linux kernel in this discussion thread https://www.spinics.net/lists/linux-rdma/index.html#61713
We have a license that's a bsd-2-clause but uses the warranty disclaimer of the MIT license. It is used in the kernel and rdma and libfabric and cannot really be changed as some of the companies using may no longer exists. 
See also https://github.com/ofiwg/libfabric/issues/3934

items.title: Create new option for license URL template
items.body:
As per #759, users are now able to specify custom license URL templates with the new command line option `--license-url-template`. The user would pass in the URL template as so: 

```scancode -l --license-url-template "https://example.com/urn:{}" example_directory``` 

where `{}` is the placeholder for the license key. Also, the field `dejacode_url` has now been renamed `reference_url`.
